title: Launch Pricing on the Per-Worker Fee for Newly Live Paystride Programs
content:
Launch pricing discounts the per-worker fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement by the whole months from the go-live date to the first day of the billing month, a month counting as whole only once the day of the month of the go-live date is reached, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day:

- fewer than 6 whole months have passed: the discount is 10 percent;
- at least 6 but fewer than 12 whole months have passed: the discount is 5 percent;
- otherwise there is no launch discount.

The go-live date is the one on the agreement record.

## Judgement table (hypothetical go-live dates)

| Go-live date | First day of the billing month | Whole months | Launch discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 1st of a month | the 1st, 5 months later | 5 | 10 percent |
| the 1st of a month | the 1st, 6 months later | 6 | 5 percent |
| the 2nd of a month | the 1st, 6 months later | 5, the 2nd not yet reached | 10 percent |
| the 1st of a month | the 1st, 12 months later | 12 | none |
| the 9th of a month | the 1st, 12 months later | 11 | 5 percent |
| 31 January | 1 July | 5, the fifth reached on 1 July, June having no 31st | 10 percent |
| 31 January | 1 August | 6, the sixth reached on 31 July | 5 percent |
